justification: Image A shows abstract, schematic linear engravings (curving lines, hook-like and geometric marks) with no clear figural iconography, while Image B shows a radial composition with a central circular figure resembling a schematic human form surrounded by radiating linear rays. There is no shared specific motif, relationship, or arrangement between the two; the only commonality is that both are incised/carved linear marks on stone, which is a medium similarity rather than a depicted-content similarity.
